blocks.text: MANILA — Former Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA) Parliament member Edrieza Nasser Rimbang is expected to appear in an investigation into an illegal drug shipment intercepted at Luang Prabang Airport in Laos on Oct. 1, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) said Thursday. PDEA spokesperson Joseph Frederick Calulut confirmed that three of Rimbang’s lawyers visited the PDEA office on Oct. 27 to inform them that their client would appear on Nov. 5 to submit his sworn statement. This followed the subpoena sent to the former Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) official for allegedly financing the chartered flight linked to the […]...
